Requirement: PR description states "the template copies are changed where they are identical or have the same wording" and explicitly calls out "apply-url: `/implement-plan-claude` 'hands it to the orchestrator' instead of 'ships it'." The changelog entry claims "the next `@stable` sync delivers the updated CLAUDE.md and template commands" with apply-url in the changed-template-copies list.
Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/apply-url.md at step 7 (the `@@ -20,7 +20,7 @@` hunk, "to ship it" -> "to hand it to the orchestrator") and the rules section (the `@@ -71,7 +71,7 @@` hunk, "`/write-plan` -> `/implement-plan-claude`" -> "`/write-plan` -> `/implement-plan-claude` on the Claude engine").
Evidence of absence: The original_pr_diff.patch shows the live copy .claude/commands/apply-url.md with 4 hunks (line ranges 6-12, 20-26, 57-63, 71-77) while the template copy workflow-templates/.claude/commands/apply-url.md has only 2 hunks (line ranges 6-12 and 57-63). The step 7 and rules hunks that exist in the live copy are absent from the template copy. The LAST RUN editor summary in entry[2] of pr_all_comments_context.txt claims "The live and template commands match exactly," which the diff contradicts: the editor added 2 hunks (6-12 and 57-63, matching the original PR's incomplete intent) but the template still lacks the line 20-26 step 7 change and the line 71-77 rules change present in the live copy. The next @stable sync will ship the apply-url template in this partially-updated state, and the changelog's table entry now lists apply-url as a "Template copy changed," making the divergence a documented-but-uncorrected drift rather than an oversight. The new test_command_context_reads_follow_claude_md assertion does not cover the step 7 or rules wording, so CI will pass while parity remains broken.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
